title: Panel bundle signature, contract version 1
description: The publisher's signature of an addon's prebuilt panel bundle (PRD 13.8, decision D8 of the panel extension architecture): panel-signature.json next to panel-manifest.json in the bundle directory, an Ed25519 signature over the bytes of panel-manifest.json, which carries the SHA-384 of every file, by the publisher's key. cms:build reads it with the generated codec PanelBundleSignatureCodecV1 and refuses the bundle with registry_panel_bundle_unsigned unless the key is one the installation trusts for the addon (cbox-cms.addons.publishers) and the signature verifies; a bundle without the file passes only in the local environment of an installation that trusts no key for the addon. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Registry\Domain\Dto\BundleSignature.

public_key.description: The publisher's Ed25519 public key, the base64 of its 32 bytes, which the installation names in cbox-cms.addons.publishers.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the bytes of panel-manifest.json, the base64 of its 64 bytes.
